```yaml
name: CI with gz-physics

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout dart
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install build dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y \
            build-essential \
            cmake \
            git \
            libboost-all-dev \
            libeigen3-dev \
            libtinyxml2-dev \
            liburdfdom-dev

      - name: Clone and build gz-physics
        run: |
          git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/gazebosim/gz-physics.git
          cd gz-physics
          mkdir build && cd build
          cmake .. \
            -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release \
            -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=/usr/local
          make -j$(nproc)
          sudo make install

      - name: Build dart
        run: |
          mkdir build && cd build
          cmake .. \
            -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
          make -j$(nproc)
          sudo make install

      - name: Run dart tests
        env:
          LD_LIBRARY_PATH: /usr/local/lib:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH
        run: |
          cd build
          ctest --output-on-failure
```
